Use this map to find the relevant step before changing fuel code or manuscript
claims. Each linked step QMD is the authoritative record of its analyses,
outputs, decisions, implications, and review state. The map describes their
connections; detailed evidence is included on the owning step's page.

## Execution and ownership

| Stage | Inputs → outputs | Authoritative record |
|---|---|---|
| 01 derive components | Committed thesis measurement/deadwood exports → separated station/transect data, dictionary, pairing audit | [F01 inputs and analyses](task-f01.qmd#inputs-and-analyses-performed) |
| 02 explore components | Derived data → component summaries, zero/dispersion candidates | [F01 analytical review](task-f01.qmd#f01-pipeline-review) |
| 03 fit phase components; 04 fit woody PCT candidates | Derived data and candidate specifications → saved fitted models, fit registries, diagnostics | [F01 model record](task-f01.qmd#rendered-provisional-model-review-register) |
| 05 evaluate candidates | Fit registries → comparisons and provisional AIC leaders | [F01 decisions and handoff](task-f01.qmd#implications-handoff-and-review-state) |
| 07 audit inference | Saved candidates, provisional leaders, and thesis references → estimand comparisons and verification tables | [RD04 inference review](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-inference-review) |
| 08 generate integrated figure | Saved models and shared inference functions → nine-panel figure, canonical estimates CSV, provenance | [RD04 display](task-rd04.qmd#completed-output) and [complete code/outputs](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-source-review) |
| Write fuel Results | F01 definitions and RD04 estimates → manuscript claims and qualifications | [RT03 narrative decisions](task-rt03.qmd#implemented-source-and-review-decisions) |
| Write fuel Methods and Discussion | Accepted upstream records → Methods wording and management interpretation | [M03](task-m03.qmd) and [D03](task-d03.qmd), currently queued |

Stages 01–05 form the analytical sequence. Stages 07 and 08 consume the saved
models and shared inference helpers; stage 07 verifies the inference used in
stage 08, rather than supplying its estimate input. Stage 06 is retired; its
stub and archived implementation belong to the
[RD04 historical source review](task-rd04.qmd#rd04-source-review).
`00-fuel-config.R` and `03-model-utils.R` are maintained with F01;
`rd04-inference-utils.R` is maintained with RD04.

## Running and updating the pipeline

Run `run-publication.bat fuel` from the repository root, using publication's
independent R 4.6.2 and renv environment. See the
[operational README](repo-files/publication/scripts/fuel/README.md) for commands.
Inputs are committed thesis exports; outputs live under `publication/outputs/fuel/`.
Historical thesis replay is a separate export operation.
Website rendering reads saved outputs and displays source; it does not refit models.

For a change, update the owning task record and code, regenerate affected
outputs, then review downstream uses. F01 changes can affect RD04 and RT03;
RD04 changes can affect RT03, Methods, and Discussion. A consumer links to the
producing step's decision and records its own use of the result. Review states
remain explicit on each task page; an upstream completed analysis does not
automatically accept a downstream claim.

The [workflow maintenance rules](workflow.qmd#documentation-responsibilities)
describe the shared documentation structure. There is no separate continuous
pipeline review: the linked step records provide the complete evidence without
a second review surface to maintain. If one becomes useful for code-agent work,
assemble it from these same step-owned sections using Quarto includes.
